title: Alerts
intro: Tune the rules, the checks that feed them and the channels that deliver them.

server_offline.name: Server offline
server_offline.hint: Fires when a server stops reporting for the configured time.

cpu_high.name: CPU high
cpu_high.hint: Fires when CPU stays above the threshold for the configured duration.

mem_high.name: Memory high
mem_high.hint: Fires when memory stays above the threshold for the configured duration.

disk_high.name: Disk high
disk_high.hint: Fires when disk usage stays above the threshold for the configured duration.

container_down.name: Container down
container_down.hint: Fires when a watched container has been stopped for the configured time.

container_unhealthy.name: Container unhealthy
container_unhealthy.hint: Fires when a container remains unhealthy for the configured time.

check_failed.name: Health check failed
check_failed.hint: Fires after a check fails the configured number of times in a row.

cert_expiry.name: Certificate expiring
cert_expiry.hint: Fires when an agent certificate is close to its expiry date.

params.for_secondsHint: Between {{min}} and {{max}} seconds above the threshold.
params.daysHint: Warn between {{min}} and {{max}} days before the certificate expires.

validation.fixFields: Check the marked fields before saving.
validation.name: Write a name within the allowed length.
validation.scope: Choose the server, group or name this rule applies to.
validation.params: Use whole numbers inside the allowed range.
validation.target: Write a valid target for this check.
validation.http: Use whole seconds and expected codes such as 200 or 200-299.
validation.secret: Fill in the secret fields required by this channel.

rules.title: Rules
rules.intro: What raises an alert, how severe it is and where it applies.
rules.empty: There are no alert rules yet.
rules.deleteBody: Rules that are deleted stop raising alerts. Built-in rules cannot be deleted.

form.name: Name
form.channelsHint: Leave all unchecked to send through every active channel.
form.noChannels: There are no channels yet; alerts will use the default delivery.

checks.title: Checks
checks.intro: HTTP, TCP and TLS probes that can trigger the rules.
checks.deleteBody: The check stops running and its results are no longer updated.

form.name: Name
form.intervalHint: At least 30 seconds and at most 24 hours.

targetHint.tcp: Host and port, for example example.com:443.
targetHint.tls: Host and port; the certificate is validated during the handshake.

form.expectedCodesHint: Comma-separated codes or ranges, for example 200, 301-399.
form.serverHint: Associating a server lets the check use its network context.

channels.title: Channels
channels.intro: Where notifications go and which language they use.
channels.empty: There are no notification channels yet.
channels.testOk: The test notification to {{name}} was delivered.
channels.deleteBody: Pending notifications for this channel will no longer be delivered.

form.name: Name
form.hmacHint: Optional; signs the payload with HMAC-SHA256.
form.signatureHint: The signature travels in the X-Talaia-Signature header over timestamp and body.

privateTargets.title: Private networks
privateTargets.intro: By default checks and notifications cannot reach loopback, private or link-local addresses.
privateTargets.allow: Allow checks and notifications to reach private networks
privateTargets.warning: Only enable this when the core and the targets live in a trusted network. It widens what a misconfigured check or webhook can reach.
privateTargets.cloudMetadata: Cloud metadata addresses always stay blocked, whatever this setting says.
